## Cognitive Module Submission

Issue:

Module ID and capability:

## Contract Artifacts

- [ ] Module Manifest v1
- [ ] Input/output schemas
- [ ] Artifact and schema hashes
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Conformance report
- [ ] Evaluation report and thresholds
- [ ] Benchmark
- [ ] Failure and unsupported cases

## Security and License

- [ ] Core changes are zero or approved RFC is linked
- [ ] Threat model
- [ ] Model card or not-applicable declaration
- [ ] Data card or no-training-data declaration
- [ ] `licenses.json` and commercial-use status
- [ ] No hidden network, raw secrets, privilege, or side effects
- [ ] Deterministic replay verified

## Repository Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --all-features`
- [ ] `cargo build --workspace --release`
- [ ] Automatic merge is disabled
